name: vm
title_zh: 从干净快照开一台用完即弃的 Omarchy 虚拟机
tagline_zh: 想试个会改系统配置的脚本，又不敢拿真桌面赌？它从 fresh 快照起一台 QEMU/KVM 虚拟机，跑完随手丢掉。
tagline_en: Want to try a script that edits system config but won't risk your real desktop? It boots a QEMU/KVM VM from the.
desc_en: Test things in a disposable Omarchy VM (QEMU/KVM on this machine) through the omavm CLI, started from the clean "fresh" snapshot. Use for "/vm", "test this in the VM", "try it in the vm", "open the VM", or whenever work needs a bare Omarchy or is too risky for the real desktop.
why_zh: 每次都从同一个 fresh 快照起，所以上一轮的脏改动不会污染这一轮；测完直接销毁，不用手动回滚。
why_en: Always boots from the same fresh snapshot, so last run's mess can't leak in; destroy it after and there's nothing to roll back.
limit_zh: 只在这台机器上跑 QEMU/KVM，宿主机没装或没开 KVM 就用不了；只覆盖 Omarchy 本身。
limit_en: Runs QEMU/KVM on this machine only — no KVM, no VM. Covers Omarchy only; other distros or real-hardware behavior are out of scope.
title_en: Boot a disposable Omarchy VM from a clean snapshot
